item.title: National parks waive entrance fees on Presidents Day
item.description: UNITED STATES — The Department of the Interior (DOI) is honoring Presidents Day by waiving entrance fees to Department-managed public lands on Monday, Feb. 16. As part of a recent change, fee-free days will allow U.S. resident visitors to enter national parks free of charge.
